objective: Qualified opportunities and evidenced pipeline movement

sales-desk-setup.acceptance: A dated sourced finding, decision or reconciliation is usable by its intended reader.
sales-desk-setup.fallback: Investigate a qualification assumption, resolve prospect evidence or prepare a personalized objection response using permitted sources.
sales-desk-setup.recovery: Refresh source facts and continue unfinished useful work in the current eligible period.
